Connect local Ollama +

On your computer, install and start Ollama and make a model available. Then clone this repository and start the lab server:

git clone https://github.com/aravinds-kannappan/Agent-Context.git
cd Agent-Context
npm start

Open the local lab ↗, choose Local Ollama, and select your installed model. Node.js 22+ is required. No API key is needed.

The hosted lab supports test mode. Real local model calls run through the localhost server; the hosted page does not contact your computer.

Oracle trials are skipped if the required four blocks do not fit. A wrong-scope-compatible action matches the other task’s solution; this is a diagnostic pattern, not proof of the model’s hidden reasoning. Partial runs are not balanced comparisons.

What should we work on next?

The next step will depend on whether the model lacked evidence, applied another task’s rule, or failed despite complete evidence.

What this first version can establish +

This is an executable prototype for checking task generation, selection, and scoring. It is a single-decision task, not a long-horizon agent benchmark. It does not yet implement token-matched interventions, confidence intervals, model-specific cost accounting, or the full confirmatory protocol.

Use model trials to find failure cases and refine the experiment. Do not infer general superiority from this small synthetic pilot. Both targets in a packet belong to the same statistical cluster.
